research.title: Sensitivity-Aware Regression with Missing Covariates
bullets: Formulated a research question on prediction stability under changing covariate missingness, distinguishing imputation error from sensitivity to missingness patterns.

Led development of a regression objective penalizing prediction variation across plausible imputations; evaluated robustness against standard imputation baselines under controlled missingness mechanisms.

research.title: Adaptive Prediction Sets under Covariate Shift
bullets: Formulated research questions about prediction set reliability under covariate shift and led development of density ratio weighted conformal calibration procedures.
Developed weight stabilization and local calibration variants; evaluated coverage, set size, and subgroup behavior using synthetic shifts and tabular classification benchmarks.

work.title: Batch Data Validation and Processing
bullets: Implemented assigned validation routines for incoming tabular records, checking required fields, data types, and duplicate identifiers before downstream processing.
Added regression tests for parsing failures and updated error messages; investigated reported processing defects and documented fixes for maintenance handoffs.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Probabilistic Classifier Calibration
bullets: Implemented logistic regression and neural network classifiers with temperature scaling and isotonic calibration using separate training, calibration, and test partitions.
Compared reliability diagrams, log loss, and calibration error across class imbalance settings, documenting sensitivity to calibration sample composition.

projects.title: Sparse Regression with Correlated Predictors
bullets: Implemented coordinate descent for lasso and elastic net regression, checking optimization convergence against reference estimators on standardized synthetic datasets.
Compared prediction error and coefficient stability across correlated feature settings, using nested cross validation to separate regularization selection from evaluation.

projects.title: Bootstrap Intervals for Regression Predictions
bullets: Implemented residual and pairs bootstrap procedures for linear regression, generating prediction intervals with explicit treatment of observation noise.
Compared empirical coverage and interval width under heteroscedasticity and model misspecification, using repeated simulations to characterize each procedure's limitations.
